summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in the repo. Changes: rich/progress.py gained a private _FileReader class, a private _ContextWrapper, a shared _build_file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file (with typed overloads for open), and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods placed next to track(). tests/test_progress.py gained 17 new tests inserted before the __main__ block. docs/source/progress.rst gained "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections under Advanced usage. CHANGELOG.md gained one Unreleased/Added bullet linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (847 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and repo code were not executed, per the instructions, so behaviour and type-check suppressions are verified by reading only. Choices made: DownloadColumn is the byte-count column with no percentage column; _FileReader defines mode and name properties so it stays instantiable on Python 3.6; close is idempotent; module code calls io.open because the module's open shadows the builtin. Nothing was committed.
